authentication: Public directory access only; no publisher API credentials or operation execution.
attribution: Preserve APIs.guru directory provenance, x-origin references, API publisher identity claims and definition version.
retention: Retain bounded directory metadata and reviewed definitions; do not fetch each declared API during E4 import.
personal_data_treatment: Do not extract contact fields into personal profiles; retain only source-declared operational metadata needed for proof.
license_notes: Directory contribution and acquired-definition terms differ; retain per-definition source and license metadata.
emergency_disable: No network job or downstream API invocation exists; malformed or oversized definitions fail closed.
initial_scope: Proposed directory metadata and candidate OpenAPI contracts only; parsing never admits a live capability.
